continuation.decision_rule: append and re-prefill samples are INTERLEAVED, so a machine regime shift moves both routes together; a point is decided only when the gap between the two routes' p50 exceeds BOTH the larger within-point p50-to-p95 spread AND the larger drift between a route's first and last sample at that point. The reported figure is a BRACKET, not a threshold.
